en: What happens when someone points out your sin?
Why? Because you have to justify yourself.

text:
하나님의 사랑에
깊은 은혜의 동기가 아니면
en: Unless it's driven by the deep grace of God's love,
and see how maddening it is.

text:
말도 되지도 않는
희한한 논리를 막 만들어내
en: They invent the strangest logic that makes no sense.

text:
절대로 죽고 싶지 않은
절대로 끊고 싶지 않는
en: Things you never want to die to, never want to give up:
you're holding on to the idols of your life.
That's why so many who've had faith for years

text:
성격이 잘 바뀌고
그런 사람들이 많지 않은 이유가

en: they keep holding on to what's theirs.
They give up only part of it.
